concept: DynamoDB: GSI vs LSI for a new access pattern
tests: Knowing the differences between GSI and LSI, including that an LSI can only be created with the table.
expected: Add a Global Secondary Index — its own partition/sort key, can be created on an existing table. Triggers: "query by a non-key attribute", "table already in production".
why_not: An LSI is created only at table creation and gives just an alternate sort key with the same partition key; Streams is a change stream, not an index; DAX is a cache, not a new access pattern.
